features.description: Teacher design-system primitives (TeacherCard, EmptyState, SettingRow, SettingsSection, AdvancedDisclosure, TeacherPage) under src/components/teacher/ui/, consolidating existing hand-rolled patterns; reuse Tailwind HSL tokens; native <details> for disclosure.
acceptance_criteria: Six primitives + index barrel exist under frontend/src/components/teacher/ui/
All primitives use token classes (bg-background/text-muted-foreground/border-border), no hard-coded colors
AdvancedDisclosure and collapsible SettingsSection toggle open/closed (tested)
SettingRow associates label to control via htmlFor/id (tested)
vitest green for all primitives; npm run quality:check:fast clean
features.notes: 6 primitives + barrel; 18 vitest cases green; quality:check:fast clean. Used cn() from @/lib/utils. AdvancedDisclosure = native <details> (no Radix collapsible). SettingsSection keeps action outside the toggle button (no nested interactives).

features.description: By-breakpoint primary nav shell: TeacherNav (left rail at md+, bottom bar at <md) with usePathname active highlight; integrate into _TeacherClientShell; minimal activities + settings index pages built on the primitives so the nav does not 404.
acceptance_criteria: TeacherNav renders 4 destinations (Classes/Activities/Insights/Settings) with active highlight via usePathname
Left rail present at >=md (md:flex), bottom bar present at <md (md:hidden) — asserted by class presence
/teacher/activities and /teacher/settings render (no 404), both via the new primitives
_TeacherClientShell still gates auth, renders header (account/sign-out/LOCAL_MODE) and AppFooter
vitest green; npm run quality:check passes (lint + typecheck + tests + build)
features.notes: TeacherNav renders both rail (hidden md:flex) + fixed bottom bar (md:hidden) from one DESTINATIONS source; usePathname active highlight; Insights matches /insights+/analytics+/reports. Shell restructured to [rail | content] row, auth-gate/loading branches untouched. Minimal activities + settings index pages built on the primitives. 14 new tests (TeacherNav 5, shell smoke 1, 2 index pages). Full suite 951 green; build OK (new routes /teacher/activities + /teacher/settings).
